tools.name: make_activity_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a UML activity diagram or a process flowchart drawn from steps, for example "draw the checkout flow as an activity diagram" or "make a PDF of this process". Takes the diagram text in a line grammar: start / stop / end; :Action text; ; if (condition) then (label) ... else

tools.name: check_activity_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants activity diagram text checked without a drawing, for example "is my flow valid?" or "which steps are not reachable?".
